# Vendored libraries (specimen only)

Copied from npm for the Stage 03.3 v2 specimen. The cloud environment blocks cdnjs, and the specimen must run offline. Production decides its own stack and versions at Stage 05.

| File | Package | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js`, `ScrollTrigger.min.js`, `Flip.min.js` | gsap | 3.13.0 | GSAP Standard "no charge" licence (https://gsap.com/standard-license) |
| `lenis.min.js` | lenis | 1.3.4 | MIT |
| `maplibre-gl.js`, `maplibre-gl.css` | maplibre-gl | 4.7.1 | BSD-3-Clause |

Map data (when bundled under `map/` by `tools/map/fetch_tiles.py`): © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL; tiles and style from OpenFreeMap.
